cache: Add contains(key), returning whether the key is currently stored even when its stored value is None.
c=Cache(); assert not c.contains("a"); c.put("a",None); c.put("b",2); assert c.contains("a") and c.contains("b") and not c.contains("x"); assert c.get("b")==2
Add update_many(mapping), storing every supplied key and value while preserving entries whose keys are absent from the mapping.
c=Cache(); c.put("a",1); c.put("b",2); c.update_many({"b":5,"c":3}); assert c.get("a")==1 and c.get("b")==5 and c.get("c")==3
events: Add first(user), returning that user's earliest recorded value, or None if the user has no events.
s=EventStore(); assert s.first("a") is None; s.record("a",1); s.record("b",8); s.record("a",3); assert s.first("a")==1 and s.first("b")==8 and s.latest("a")==3
Add replace_latest(user, value), replacing and returning that user's latest recorded value without changing the order of other events. Return None and record nothing when the user has no event.

s=EventStore(); s.record("a",1); s.record("b",8); s.record("a",3); assert s.replace_latest("a",5)==3; assert s.latest("a")==5 and s.latest("b")==8; assert s.replace_latest("x",7) is None; assert s.latest("x") is None
flags: Add delete(name), returning the previous boolean value or None when the feature was not configured. A deleted feature must subsequently read as disabled.
f=FeatureFlags(); f.set("search",True); assert f.delete("search") is True; assert not f.get("search"); assert f.delete("search") is None; assert f.delete("missing") is None
Add enabled(), returning a sorted detached list containing the names of all currently enabled features.
f=FeatureFlags(); f.set("search",True); f.set("export",False); f.set("zeta",True); x=f.enabled(); assert x==["search","zeta"]; x.clear(); assert f.get("search")
permissions: Add grant(role, action), adding one permission to a role. An unknown role must be created with no other permissions.

p=Permissions(); p.grant("viewer","comment"); assert p.allowed("viewer","read") and p.allowed("viewer","comment"); p.grant("auditor","audit"); assert p.allowed("auditor","audit") and not p.allowed("auditor","read")
Add roles_for(action), returning a sorted detached list of every role currently allowed to perform that action.
p=Permissions(); x=p.roles_for("read"); assert x==["editor","viewer"]; x.clear(); assert p.allowed("viewer","read"); assert p.roles_for("write")==["editor"]; assert p.roles_for("missing")==[]
pricing: Add remove_plan(plan), returning the removed discount fraction. The removed plan must become invalid, and removing an unknown plan must raise KeyError.

e=PriceEngine(); assert e.remove_plan("pro")==0.10
try: e.price("pro",100); assert False
except KeyError: pass
try: e.remove_plan("missing"); assert False
except KeyError: pass
assert e.price("basic",20)==20
Add discounts(), returning a detached dictionary that maps every currently supported plan to its fractional discount.
e=PriceEngine(); d=e.discounts(); assert d=={"basic":0.0,"pro":0.10}; d["pro"]=0.8; assert e.price("pro",100)==90
router: Add rename(old_path, new_path), moving an exact route and returning its target. Return None for a missing old path. The old path must no longer resolve after a successful rename.
r=Router(); assert r.rename("/health","/status")=="ok"; assert r.resolve("/health") is None and r.resolve("/status")=="ok"; assert r.rename("/missing","/x") is None; assert r.resolve("/")=="home"
Add paths_for(target), returning a sorted detached list of every exact path currently mapped to that target.
r=Router(); assert r.paths_for("home")==["/"]; assert r.paths_for("ok")==["/health"]; assert r.paths_for("missing")==[]; x=r.paths_for("home"); x.clear(); assert r.resolve("/")=="home"
